hy_ig_spread_pct.description: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS minus ICE BofA US Corporate (IG) OAS, in percentage points (e.g. 2.99 = 2.99%). Monthly end-of-period values. Column named _pct per DATA-D12 and backward-compat with Evan S6 signal code. SOURCING CONSTRAINT: FRED ICE licensing restricts history to 3 years as of April 2026; delivered sample 2023-06-30 to 2026-04-30.

spy_log_return.description: SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) monthly log return: log(adjusted_close_end_of_month / adjusted_close_prev_end_of_month). Dimensionless log return (e.g. 0.0166 ≈ 1.67% simple return). Computed from Yahoo Finance daily adjusted close.
spy_log_return.source_reference: Yahoo Finance: SPY adjusted close (daily -> month-end -> log return)
